s: t1098|caption \u2028\u2028what\u2019s it like?\u2028\u2028this is probably the question I get most often about my shamanic healing sessions, so I wanted to pull back the curtain a little bit.\u2028\u2028the way clients describe it is: part conversation, part psychic reading, part coaching - mixed with crystals, drumming, and energy healing. it\u2019s hard to describe exactly, but almost everyone has some version of the same responses:\u2028\u2028\u201cI feel so much calmer\u201d\u2028\u201cthat was not what I expected\u201d\u2028\u201cwhen can I do another\u201d\u2028\u2028most clients don\u2019t actually know what they\u2019re looking for when they book. they just know something feels off, stuck, or ready to be cleared.\u2028\u2028you don\u2019t need to have the answers or even an inkling of what\u2019s going on. you just need an intention for the session.\u2028\u2028my job is to work with the helping spirits to see what\u2019s ready to shift or come to light, and then do whatever is needed to facilitate that transformation.\u2028\u2028I offer private and small-group sessions virtually and in person in westport, ct.\u2028\u2028dm me to learn more \ud83e\udd0d xx donnie

t1107|\u000aWORDS FOR YOUR JOURNEY\u00a0\u000aYOU ALREADY KNOW\u2028 The emotional world: over-asking, looking for more signs, knowing but not being ready, waiting for an easier answer.\u000aVisuals:\u000aknowing looks\u000araised eyebrows\u000aleaving the room\u000atext threads/group-chat memes\u000atarot/sign memes\u000aroad signs\u000amirrors\u000acrossroads\u000asomeone putting their phone down\u000a\u201cgirl\u2026\u201d energy\u000aPossible lines:\u000aYou may be waiting for a different answer, not a clearer one.\u000aClarity and readiness are not the same thing.\u000aSometimes asking again is a way of avoiding the answer.\u000aThe answer doesn\u2019t become less true because it asks something of you.\u000aYou can stop reopening what you already know.\u000aSometimes the next sign is the one you already received.

t1109|Caption\u000a\u2028September is asking us to ground.\u000a\u000aGrounding isn't about the activity, it's about where you end up: back in your body, back in the present, back in a sense of safety.\u000a\u000aSo many of us live from the neck up, thinking and thinking because it feels like control. But that's often what leaves us feeling swirly and untethered.\u000a\u000aA long shower. Cooking without your phone. Feet on the earth. If it brings you back, it counts.\u000a\u000aSeptember Crystal Allies:\u000a\u000aBlack Tourmaline ~ grounding that protects\u000aSmoky Quartz ~ grounding that transforms\u000aRhodonite ~ grounding with compassion\u000aRed Jasper ~ grounding like a grandmother you love\u000aMontana Agate ~ grounding that balances
